subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this issue remain the distinct tracker for Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery proof, or be folded into the broader Telegram guarded-lane recovery work?
rationale: The source evidence supports overlap with the broader ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that are not fully owned by the related open issue or PR.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open for proof and fix work specific to reasoning preview/final delivery and any confirmed Control UI history backpressure.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Telegram Recovery
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 as the canonical issue if maintainers decide the reasoning/history details are symptoms of the same ambiguous-send recovery contract.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Track Telegram ambiguous-send recovery here or in the related issue, and create or select a separate item only if the `chat.history` burst is independently reproduced.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for proof and fix work specific to reasoning preview/final delivery and any confirmed Control UI history backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: Nik has recent merged history in the adjacent Telegram guarded-lane recovery path that would likely shape this decision.
